## Column Body Outset Left Test

This tests the `.column-body-outset-left` class which extends content to the left.

::: {.column-body-outset-left}
OUTSET-LEFT-CONTENT: This content should extend into the left margin while keeping the right edge aligned with the body column.
:::

Regular text for comparison.
